product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Rangoli Tealight Decor Set
product_description: Brighten your festive celebrations with this handcrafted rangoli decor set, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, golden detailing, pearl embellishments, and decorative tealight holders. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rituals, and elegant festive home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Handle pearls and decorative embellishments carefully.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface when using candles.
Keep flames away from fabric and decorative elements; LED tealights are recommended.
Store flat in a dry, protective box when not in use.
